name: starter-template
description: Global Payments SDK starter template for multiple languages

scripts.start: concurrently --names "node,php,dotnet,java" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,magenta,green" "npm start --prefix nodejs" "php -S 0.0.0.0:8000" "dotnet run --project dotnet" "bash -c 'cd java && mvn cargo:run'"
